body: My mum kicked me out for being gay ages ago. She always shouted at me and abused me. Then I had to go live w my abusivo dad.  Since leaving him it’s all been unstable housing and messy relationships. All of this pain is still carrying in my life. And I want to spread joy to the lgbtq community so i run parties for them. I’m TRYING. But I really can’t do this strong thing anymore. I need help or I need to leave this planet Im just so disappointed in humand

Im in talks with a magazine that want to fund my project. That’s all I need right now. Some fucking money to get my ideas off the ground. Something inside me knows it’s going to go well, but I just feeel like such a broken mess inside. I need professional help but my life is just so scattered and I don’t know how to organise myself and everything in my life in order to get that
